entries.name: AuthManager
entries.summary: Coordinates native account changes with the same profile gate used by execution.

entries.name: AuthManager.dispose
entries.summary: Cancels all login/status/logout work and awaits owned native cleanup.

entries.name: AuthManager.logout
entries.summary: Cancels/drains a profile's login and executions before removing its native credentials.

entries.name: AuthManager.start
entries.summary: Starts one explicit login, cancelling and draining any older login for that profile.

entries.name: AuthManager.status
entries.summary: Performs a bounded native status check without initiating login, hooks or inference.

entries.name: AuthState
entries.summary: Correlated authentication lifecycle snapshots containing no submitted credential values.

entries.name: IAuthHandle
entries.summary: One login's current state, bounded history and awaited native completion.

entries.name: IAuthHandle.cancel
entries.summary: Cancels this flow and waits for native teardown, including queued starts.

entries.name: IAuthHandle.events
entries.summary: Bounded snapshots; result completion never depends on consuming this iterable.

entries.name: IAuthHandle.respond
entries.summary: Provides in-memory input to the current owner-scoped interaction.

entries.name: IAuthHandle.result
entries.summary: Resolves only after native login and status verification; rejects after cleanup on failure.

entries.name: IAuthHandle.state
entries.summary: Authoritative latest snapshot even when older events were dropped.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions
entries.summary: Bounded authentication lifecycle policy and deterministic test seams.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.createId
entries.summary: Correlation ID factory; defaults to randomUUID and must produce unique nonempty values.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.defaultTimeoutMs
entries.summary: Default total login lifetime in milliseconds; defaults to 300000, maximum 1800000.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.eventCapacity
entries.summary: Maximum retained event snapshots; defaults to 64. Older snapshots are dropped on overflow.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.maxPendingOperations
entries.summary: Maximum live/tearing-down login operations; defaults to 64.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.now
entries.summary: UTC epoch-millisecond clock; defaults to Date.now and is read only on explicit operations.

entries.name: IAuthManagerOptions.statusTimeoutMs
entries.summary: Background status deadline in milliseconds; defaults to 5000, maximum 30000.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity
entries.summary: Correlation and ownership shared by every state of one native login.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.driverId
entries.summary: Open implementation identifier owning the native procedure.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.expiresAt
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds after which the operation is cancelled.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.instanceId
entries.summary: Instance whose native credentials are changing.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.operationId
entries.summary: Unique authentication flow identifier, never reused by a manager.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.ownerId
entries.summary: Host interaction owner authorized to provide secret responses.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.profileId
entries.summary: Isolated account profile whose execution admission is blocked.

entries.name: IAuthOperationIdentity.startedAt
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds when this operation started.

entries.name: IAuthStartOptions
entries.summary: Explicit owner and procedure selected for one bounded native login.

entries.name: IAuthStartOptions.methodId
entries.summary: Driver-local procedure identifier returned by its methods function.

entries.name: IAuthStartOptions.ownerId
entries.summary: Host owner allowed to respond; it must be stable for the lifetime of this flow.

entries.name: IAuthStartOptions.signal
entries.summary: Optional host cancellation, propagated through native teardown.

entries.name: IAuthStartOptions.timeoutMs
entries.summary: Total lifetime in milliseconds, including queue/drain time; defaults to the manager policy.

entries.name: IProfileManagerOptions
entries.summary: Application-owned storage options for isolated CLI profiles.

entries.name: IProfileManagerOptions.maxProfiles
entries.summary: Maximum remembered profile mappings per manager; defaults to 1024.

entries.name: IProfileManagerOptions.rootDirectory
entries.summary: Absolute private storage root. Construction performs no filesystem access.

entries.name: IProfileRequest
entries.summary: Stable application/account identity and optional existing native CLI locations.

entries.name: IProfileRequest.accountId
entries.summary: Host-defined account identifier, never a credential value.

entries.name: IProfileRequest.applicationId
entries.summary: Application owner, never an authentication secret.

entries.name: IProfileRequest.driverId
entries.summary: Open driver identifier used to separate native configuration formats.

entries.name: IProfileRequest.id
entries.summary: Optional existing stable profile identity; otherwise derived from the owner tuple.

entries.name: IProfileRequest.paths
entries.summary: Explicit absolute legacy paths; absent locations use isolated profile defaults.

entries.name: ProfileManager
entries.summary: Creates isolated application/account directories without importing global credentials.

entries.name: ProfileManager.create
entries.summary: Creates or reopens one immutable isolated profile, preserving explicit legacy mappings.

entries.name: AiAuthDriverBase
entries.summary: Replaceable native authentication procedures, without an application token broker.

entries.name: AiAuthDriverBase.login
entries.summary: Performs the selected explicit native login while the auth owner holds exclusive profile access.

entries.name: AiAuthDriverBase.logout
entries.summary: Removes this isolated account's native credentials after its executions drain.

entries.name: AiAuthDriverBase.methods
entries.summary: Lists supported procedures without login or ambient credential discovery.

entries.name: AiAuthDriverBase.status
entries.summary: Verifies native CLI account state without launching a login or hooks.

entries.name: AiDriverBase
entries.summary: Replaceable CLI/protocol implementation; construction and imports remain inert.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.auth
entries.summary: Optional supported native authentication owner.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.capabilities
entries.summary: Execution guarantees that are enforced before launch.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.dispose
entries.summary: Releases implementation-owned resources after all its executions have been cancelled.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.execute
entries.summary: Executes one native turn in the selected profile and prepared workspace.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.id
entries.summary: Open implementation identifier; registration never requires a central provider enum.

entries.name: AiDriverBase.inspect
entries.summary: Explicitly inspects bounded metadata without initiating login or inference.

entries.name: AiError
entries.summary: Stable failure with explicit retry and session recovery semantics.

entries.name: AiError.capacityScope
entries.summary: Explicit provider-reported capacity scope, if known.

entries.name: AiError.cleanupIncomplete
entries.summary: Whether native process termination remains unconfirmed; affected profile execution and credential changes must remain blocked.

entries.name: AiError.code
entries.summary: Stable provider-neutral failure classification.

entries.name: AiError.retryAt
entries.summary: Optional UTC epoch-millisecond recovery instant.

entries.name: AiError.retryable
entries.summary: Whether an explicitly repeatable operation may retry this failure.

entries.name: AiError.sessionUsable
entries.summary: Whether the originating native session remains usable.

entries.name: AiErrorCode
entries.summary: Stable failure categories used for routing, recovery and host translation.

entries.name: AiEvent
entries.summary: Bounded normalized execution events, without raw protocol frames or credentials.

entries.name: AiRouteExecutorBase
entries.summary: Optional routing owner injected into the runtime, independent of concrete drivers.

entries.name: AiRouteExecutorBase.dispose
entries.summary: Releases route-owned queues and bounded metadata state.

entries.name: AiRouteExecutorBase.execute
entries.summary: Selects and executes eligible candidates under explicit host retry policy.

entries.name: AiTarget
entries.summary: Explicit instance selection or an injected host-configured route.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext
entries.summary: Explicit native login execution with host-owned interaction presentation.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext.instance
entries.summary: Isolated account instance being authenticated.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext.interaction
entries.summary: Present a native interaction; auth owner validates identity and expiry.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext.methodId
entries.summary: Actually supported method selected by the host.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext.response
entries.summary: Await an owner-validated response, cancelled when this flow ends.

entries.name: IAiAuthContext.signal
entries.summary: Authentication expiry/cancellation signal.

entries.name: IAiAuthField
entries.summary: One declared input for a native credentials interaction.

entries.name: IAiAuthField.id
entries.summary: Stable input identity used in the response values map.

entries.name: IAiAuthField.label
entries.summary: User-facing input label.

entries.name: IAiAuthField.required
entries.summary: Whether a response must include this input.

entries.name: IAiAuthField.secret
entries.summary: Whether the value is a secret and must never be logged.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction
entries.summary: One correlated, expiring native authentication interaction.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.code
entries.summary: Device/user verification code, only for this interaction.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.expiresAt
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds; responses after expiry fail.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.fields
entries.summary: Declared credentials inputs where supported.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.id
entries.summary: Unique interaction identifier; stale responses are rejected.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.message
entries.summary: Safe user instruction, never a raw environment/credential dump.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.type
entries.summary: Extensible interaction discriminator, e.g. browser/device-code/terminal/credentials.

entries.name: IAiAuthInteraction.url
entries.summary: Native login URL for an explicit user interaction.

entries.name: IAiAuthMethod
entries.summary: An authentication procedure actually supported by a driver.

entries.name: IAiAuthMethod.id
entries.summary: Driver-local method identifier.

entries.name: IAiAuthMethod.kind
entries.summary: Required native interaction family.

entries.name: IAiAuthMethod.label
entries.summary: Human-readable procedure name.

entries.name: IAiAuthResponse
entries.summary: Owner-scoped response to a single active authentication interaction.

entries.name: IAiAuthResponse.interactionId
entries.summary: Current interaction identifier.

entries.name: IAiAuthResponse.operationId
entries.summary: Current authentication flow identifier.

entries.name: IAiAuthResponse.ownerId
entries.summary: Host owner that started the authentication flow.

entries.name: IAiAuthResponse.values
entries.summary: Input values; never logged, persisted or exposed as progress.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus
entries.summary: Verified native CLI account state without reusable credential values.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.accountId
entries.summary: Safe provider account identifier, if exposed.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.authenticated
entries.summary: Whether the CLI verified an authenticated account.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.displayName
entries.summary: Safe account display name, if exposed.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.message
entries.summary: Safe bounded status explanation; never raw CLI output.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.method
entries.summary: Verified native authentication family, e.g. chatgpt, subscription or api-key; absent when unknown.

entries.name: IAiAuthStatus.plan
entries.summary: Subscription/account plan metadata, if exposed.

entries.name: IAiCapabilities
entries.summary: Execution guarantees that a driver actually implements.

entries.name: IAiCapabilities.modes
entries.summary: Native execution policies that can be enforced before launch.

entries.name: IAiCapabilities.resume
entries.summary: Whether native sessions can be resumed for the same profile/candidate.

entries.name: IAiCapabilities.structuredOutput
entries.summary: Native schema support or local result validation availability.

entries.name: IAiCapabilities.tools
entries.summary: Whether the driver supports agent tool operations.

entries.name: IAiDriverResult
entries.summary: One native turn outcome before runtime binding and schema validation.

entries.name: IAiDriverResult.sessionId
entries.summary: Native session identifier returned by this driver.

entries.name: IAiDriverResult.structured
entries.summary: Optional native structured result; still validated against the requested schema.

entries.name: IAiDriverResult.text
entries.summary: Final generated text, separate from progress or thinking output.

entries.name: IAiDriverResult.usage
entries.summary: Latest cumulative usage for this execution.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions
entries.summary: Recovery information that never turns host failure into a retryable provider error.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.capacityScope
entries.summary: Explicit capacity scope; an unscoped/model-only failure must not pause an entire account.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.cause
entries.summary: Internal cause for diagnostics; consumers must redact before serialization.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.cleanupIncomplete
entries.summary: True when owned process termination could not be confirmed. Forces a nonretryable host failure and unusable session; inherited flagged causes cannot be cleared by false.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.retryAt
entries.summary: Optional absolute UTC epoch milliseconds after a quota/cooldown expires.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.retryable
entries.summary: Whether this provider failure may be retried when host policy also permits it.

entries.name: IAiErrorOptions.sessionUsable
entries.summary: Whether a failed turn left the same native session usable; default true.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext
entries.summary: Explicit per-turn context passed into a replaceable driver.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.emit
entries.summary: Publish normalized events; callback errors must propagate and stop execution.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.instance
entries.summary: Selected isolated instance.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.request
entries.summary: Host request with selected target and preserved policy.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.session
entries.summary: Bind a native session ID to this driver/profile/candidate.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.signal
entries.summary: Combined runtime deadline/cancellation signal.

entries.name: IAiExecutionContext.workingDirectory
entries.summary: Prepared workspace; may be a non-Git text workspace.

entries.name: IAiInspection
entries.summary: Explicit bounded provider/account/model metadata inspection.

entries.name: IAiInspection.auth
entries.summary: Verified account state.

entries.name: IAiInspection.limits
entries.summary: Optional account/model usage limits and reset instants.

entries.name: IAiInspection.models
entries.summary: Provider-advertised models; the consumer owns eligibility and catalog policy.

entries.name: IAiInstance
entries.summary: One configured driver instance with independent account and model state.

entries.name: IAiInstance.configuration
entries.summary: Driver-specific validated options, kept behind the driver boundary.

entries.name: IAiInstance.driverId
entries.summary: Open driver identifier registered explicitly by the consumer.

entries.name: IAiInstance.environment
entries.summary: Explicit host environment additions, including optional credentials; never log them.

entries.name: IAiInstance.executable
entries.summary: Optional explicit native CLI executable; discovery occurs only on use.

entries.name: IAiInstance.id
entries.summary: Host-defined instance identifier, unique within one runtime.

entries.name: IAiInstance.profile
entries.summary: Application/account profile owned by this instance.

entries.name: IAiLimit
entries.summary: Provider-reported usage or capacity window.

entries.name: IAiLimit.kind
entries.summary: Short rate window or longer account quota.

entries.name: IAiLimit.limit
entries.summary: Total capacity in the same scale as remaining.

entries.name: IAiLimit.remaining
entries.summary: Remaining units or percentage in the documented provider scale.

entries.name: IAiLimit.resetsAt
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds for the next reset.

entries.name: IAiLimit.scope
entries.summary: Explicit provider scope; a model-only 429 does not block every account model.

entries.name: IAiModel
entries.summary: Safe provider metadata, distinct from consumer model-catalog policy.

entries.name: IAiModel.defaultReasoningEffort
entries.summary: Provider-advertised default reasoning setting, if known.

entries.name: IAiModel.description
entries.summary: Provider-supplied model description, without consumer catalog policy.

entries.name: IAiModel.id
entries.summary: Provider-native model identifier.

entries.name: IAiModel.isDefault
entries.summary: Whether the provider advertises this as its native default.

entries.name: IAiModel.name
entries.summary: Optional provider-supplied display name.

entries.name: IAiModel.reasoningDescriptions
entries.summary: Safe explanations keyed by the advertised native reasoning setting.

entries.name: IAiModel.reasoningEfforts
entries.summary: Advertised native reasoning settings, if known.

entries.name: IAiPolicy
entries.summary: Host authorization and retry intent for an execution.

entries.name: IAiPolicy.allowWriteRetry
entries.summary: Additional explicit permission to replay a writing operation; default false.

entries.name: IAiPolicy.allowedTools
entries.summary: Optional tool allowlist; drivers must reject unsupported enforcement.

entries.name: IAiPolicy.deniedTools
entries.summary: Optional tool denylist; drivers must reject unsupported enforcement.

entries.name: IAiPolicy.mode
entries.summary: Required native filesystem policy; unsupported modes fail before launch.

entries.name: IAiPolicy.repeatable
entries.summary: Explicit permission to replay a failed transient text/read operation; default false.

entries.name: IAiProfile
entries.summary: Stable identity and isolated storage of one application and account.

entries.name: IAiProfile.accountId
entries.summary: Host-defined account identity, never an authentication secret.

entries.name: IAiProfile.applicationId
entries.summary: Application owner; two applications must not share mutable profiles.

entries.name: IAiProfile.id
entries.summary: Stable profile identifier; sessions bind to this value.

entries.name: IAiProfile.paths
entries.summary: Explicit profile paths, including supported legacy mappings.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths
entries.summary: Filesystem locations explicitly owned by one application/account profile.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.configuration
entries.summary: CLI configuration location, mapped explicitly for legacy profiles.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.credentials
entries.summary: Native CLI credential location; never a token value.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.execution
entries.summary: Execution-only state, separate from credentials when supported.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.home
entries.summary: Isolated HOME/USERPROFILE directory used by the CLI.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.root
entries.summary: Profile root, normally a private application-owned directory.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.sqlite
entries.summary: Optional native CLI database directory; host application databases are separate.

entries.name: IAiProfilePaths.temporary
entries.summary: Private temporary directory for profile-owned subprocess files.

entries.name: IAiRequest
entries.summary: One text or agent operation; business prompts and policy remain host-owned.

entries.name: IAiRequest.deadline
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch milliseconds; includes queue and execution time.

entries.name: IAiRequest.model
entries.summary: Optional provider-native model ID, selected by the host catalog.

entries.name: IAiRequest.onEvent
entries.summary: Optional critical host progress/persistence callback; failure cancels without retry.

entries.name: IAiRequest.outputSchema
entries.summary: Optional JSON Schema; the actual final output is locally validated.

entries.name: IAiRequest.policy
entries.summary: Native execution authorization and explicit repeatability.

entries.name: IAiRequest.prompt
entries.summary: Host-composed prompt, supplied to native CLIs through stdin when supported.

entries.name: IAiRequest.reasoningEffort
entries.summary: Optional native reasoning setting, validated by the driver.

entries.name: IAiRequest.session
entries.summary: Optional continuation bound to the selected driver/profile/candidate.

entries.name: IAiRequest.signal
entries.summary: Caller cancellation; abort never causes failover.

entries.name: IAiRequest.target
entries.summary: Explicit instance or route; no automatic global provider discovery.

entries.name: IAiRequest.workingDirectory
entries.summary: Existing host workspace; omitted text jobs receive a private non-Git workspace.

entries.name: IAiResult
entries.summary: Final result of the same execution represented by the event handle.

entries.name: IAiResult.candidateId
entries.summary: Actual route candidate selected by the host routing policy.

entries.name: IAiResult.driverId
entries.summary: Driver that completed this execution.

entries.name: IAiResult.instanceId
entries.summary: Instance that completed this execution.

entries.name: IAiResult.profileId
entries.summary: Application/account profile used by this execution.

entries.name: IAiResult.session
entries.summary: Continuation reference bound to the actual selected execution owner.

entries.name: IAiResult.structured
entries.summary: Locally schema-validated result, present when a schema was requested.

entries.name: IAiResult.text
entries.summary: Final generated text.

entries.name: IAiResult.usage
entries.summary: Latest cumulative execution usage.

entries.name: IAiRunHandle
entries.summary: One bounded event stream and one completion promise for a single operation.

entries.name: IAiRunHandle.cancel
entries.summary: Abort and await this operation; repeated cancellation is safe. Rejects with a nonretryable host error when owned process termination cannot be confirmed.

entries.name: IAiRunHandle.events
entries.summary: Optional-consumption stream; a slow/absent consumer cannot block result completion.

entries.name: IAiRunHandle.result
entries.summary: Final result; rejects with a typed failure after owned execution cleanup.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference
entries.summary: Native continuation identity bound to its complete execution owner.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.authenticationGeneration
entries.summary: Original account/storage generation. Runtime-created references always include it; omission is reserved for imported legacy native IDs before the first authentication/configuration transition.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.candidateId
entries.summary: Routing candidate identity; foreign candidates cannot reuse native state.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.driverId
entries.summary: Driver that created the native session.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.instanceId
entries.summary: Configured instance that created the session.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.nativeId
entries.summary: Opaque native session identifier, never forwarded across providers.

entries.name: IAiSessionReference.profileId
entries.summary: Application/account profile that owns the session.

entries.name: IAiUsage
entries.summary: Latest cumulative token usage reported for one execution.

entries.name: IAiUsage.cachedInput
entries.summary: Input tokens served from cache.

entries.name: IAiUsage.input
entries.summary: Input tokens, including cached input if the provider includes it.

entries.name: IAiUsage.output
entries.summary: Generated output tokens.

entries.name: IAiUsage.total
entries.summary: Total input plus output tokens; consumers replace prior snapshots.

entries.name: encodeSessionReference
entries.summary: Encodes the complete binding and authentication generation into an opaque host storage field.

entries.name: isCleanupIncomplete
entries.summary: Recognizes an explicitly unconfirmed process-cleanup failure through bounded Error causes and aggregates.

entries.name: parseSessionReference
entries.summary: Decodes a stored binding without stamping current credentials onto legacy native IDs.

entries.name: AcpDriver
entries.summary: Generic installed-agent ACP stdio adapter using the official TypeScript SDK.

entries.name: AcpDriver.auth
entries.summary: Optional separately verified native authentication implementation.

entries.name: AcpDriver.capabilities
entries.summary: Host-declared native policy modes, with resume verified again through negotiation.

entries.name: AcpDriver.dispose
entries.summary: Stops and awaits processes owned by this explicitly injected runner.

entries.name: AcpDriver.execute
entries.summary: Negotiates the agent, binds a session, enforces configured native policy and executes one turn.

entries.name: AcpDriver.id
entries.summary: Open implementation ID, defaulting to acp.

entries.name: AcpDriver.inspect
entries.summary: Performs only bounded initialization and optional independent native account verification.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions
entries.summary: Explicit native ACP configuration; the host attests the meaning of each advertised policy mode.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.args
entries.summary: Native CLI arguments used for its stdio ACP mode; never an installer command.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.auth
entries.summary: Optional verified native CLI auth adapter; ACP alone exposes no safe account-status check.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.id
entries.summary: Open driver identity; use distinct IDs for agents with different native policy guarantees.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.maxMessageBytes
entries.summary: Maximum incoming protocol frame bytes; default 1 MiB, with a separate process-output limit.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.maxOutputBytes
entries.summary: Maximum combined process output bytes for one connection; default 4 MiB.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.modeIds
entries.summary: Trusted mapping to native read-only/workspace-write modes. Missing modes are unsupported.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.modelConfigId
entries.summary: Optional advertised session-config ID controlling the native model.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.permission
entries.summary: Optional host permission decision. Without it, every tool permission request is denied.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.reasoningConfigId
entries.summary: Optional advertised session-config ID controlling native reasoning effort.

entries.name: IAcpDriverOptions.resume
entries.summary: Whether resume may be negotiated; session/load is still checked during initialize. Default true.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionOption
entries.summary: One native ACP permission decision, without raw tool inputs or credentials.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionOption.id
entries.summary: Native opaque option ID that may be returned by the host.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionOption.kind
entries.summary: Native permission family, such as allow_once or reject_once.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionOption.label
entries.summary: Safe bounded display label.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest
entries.summary: Safe host decision context for one tool permission request in the active ACP session.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest.kind
entries.summary: Protocol-reported tool kind, if provided.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest.options
entries.summary: Actual options offered by the native agent.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest.sessionId
entries.summary: Bound native session ID.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest.title
entries.summary: Safe bounded tool label; raw inputs and command output are excluded.

entries.name: IAcpPermissionRequest.toolCallId
entries.summary: Opaque native tool invocation ID.

entries.name: ClaudeAuthDriver
entries.summary: Native subscription, console and SSO authentication without a Synapse token broker.

entries.name: ClaudeAuthDriver.login
entries.summary: Runs one explicitly selected native browser procedure with optional manual-code input.

entries.name: ClaudeAuthDriver.logout
entries.summary: Signs out only the selected native configuration/keychain service.

entries.name: ClaudeAuthDriver.methods
entries.summary: Lists only procedures supported by the characterized native CLI.

entries.name: ClaudeAuthDriver.status
entries.summary: Verifies the selected native profile without login, inference or MCP sessions.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver
entries.summary: Native Claude print/stream-json adapter with explicit account and permission isolation.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.auth
entries.summary: Native procedures sharing this driver's owned subprocess boundary.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.capabilities
entries.summary: Native plan/acceptEdits permissions, continuation and schema output support.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.dispose
entries.summary: Stops and awaits every native execution/login owned by this driver.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.execute
entries.summary: Executes one native print turn without putting the prompt in process arguments.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.id
entries.summary: Open identity used for explicit consumer registration.

entries.name: ClaudeDriver.inspect
entries.summary: Explicitly inspects bounded metadata without initiating login or inference.

entries.name: CodexAuthDriver
entries.summary: Native Codex login procedures scoped to one application's account profile.

entries.name: CodexAuthDriver.login
entries.summary: Runs one explicitly chosen native login; the shared auth owner verifies status afterward.

entries.name: CodexAuthDriver.logout
entries.summary: Signs out only this account and removes its owned execution credential snapshots.

entries.name: CodexAuthDriver.methods
entries.summary: Describes the native procedures supported by the characterized Codex CLI.

entries.name: CodexAuthDriver.status
entries.summary: Checks only native login status, without inference, hooks or a login attempt.

entries.name: CodexDriver
entries.summary: Native Codex exec/JSONL adapter with isolated credentials and legacy-compatible sessions.

entries.name: CodexDriver.auth
entries.summary: Native account procedures sharing the driver's subprocess owner.

entries.name: CodexDriver.capabilities
entries.summary: Native sandbox, resume and schema capabilities enforced by this adapter.

entries.name: CodexDriver.dispose
entries.summary: Stops owned native processes and awaits queued same-profile operations.

entries.name: CodexDriver.execute
entries.summary: Executes one turn through native Codex exec; prompts never enter argv.

entries.name: CodexDriver.id
entries.summary: Open driver identity used for explicit runtime registration.

entries.name: CodexDriver.inspect
entries.summary: Inspects metadata through a separate credential-only native home, without agent startup.

entries.name: ICodexAccountUsage
entries.summary: Safe native Codex account metadata retained for host integrations.

entries.name: ICodexAccountUsage.credits
entries.summary: Optional native account-credit information.

entries.name: ICodexAccountUsage.planType
entries.summary: Native account/subscription plan name when reported.

entries.name: ICodexAccountUsage.tokenUsage
entries.summary: Optional native account usage statistics.

entries.name: ICodexAccountUsage.windows
entries.summary: Native primary and secondary capacity windows.

entries.name: ICodexCredits
entries.summary: Safe native account-credit metadata, without reusable credentials.

entries.name: ICodexCredits.balance
entries.summary: Native formatted credit balance when available.

entries.name: ICodexCredits.hasCredits
entries.summary: Whether the native account reports available paid credits.

entries.name: ICodexCredits.unlimited
entries.summary: Whether the native account reports unlimited credits.

entries.name: ICodexInspection
entries.summary: Generic inspection plus safe native usage details used by existing desktop consumers.

entries.name: ICodexInspection.auth
entries.summary: Verified account state.

entries.name: ICodexInspection.limits
entries.summary: Optional account/model usage limits and reset instants.

entries.name: ICodexInspection.metadataWarnings
entries.summary: Safe optional-metadata degradation categories; raw RPC errors never cross this boundary.

entries.name: ICodexInspection.models
entries.summary: Provider-advertised models; the consumer owns eligibility and catalog policy.

entries.name: ICodexInspection.usage
entries.summary: Optional native account/subscription usage details.

entries.name: ICodexTokenUsage
entries.summary: Native account usage statistics, distinct from per-turn token usage.

entries.name: ICodexTokenUsage.currentStreakDays
entries.summary: Native current activity streak in calendar days.

entries.name: ICodexTokenUsage.lifetimeTokens
entries.summary: Native lifetime token total when reported.

entries.name: ICodexTokenUsage.peakDailyTokens
entries.summary: Native highest daily token total when reported.

entries.name: ICodexUsageWindow
entries.summary: One native account usage window normalized without consumer catalog policy.

entries.name: ICodexUsageWindow.remainingPercent
entries.summary: Remaining percentage in the same native scale.

entries.name: ICodexUsageWindow.resetsAt
entries.summary: Absolute UTC epoch-millisecond reset instant.

entries.name: ICodexUsageWindow.usedPercent
entries.summary: Used percentage clamped to the inclusive range zero to one hundred.

entries.name: ICodexUsageWindow.windowDurationMinutes
entries.summary: Duration of the native rolling window in minutes.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration
entries.summary: Optional native OpenCode settings supplied in an instance's configuration record.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.authMethod
entries.summary: Exact native login method label; prevents ambiguous interactive method selection.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.deniedCommands
entries.summary: Native bash permission patterns the host explicitly forbids, such as git push*.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.gateway
entries.summary: Optional explicitly configured compatible provider; no gateway is installed by Synapse.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.model
entries.summary: Optional fallback native provider/model ID; a request model takes precedence.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.providerId
entries.summary: Provider account to inspect/authenticate; required for native login and logout.

entries.name: IOpenCodeConfiguration.variant
entries.summary: Optional fallback reasoning variant; a request setting takes precedence.

entries.name: IOpenCodeGateway
entries.summary: Explicit host-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint understood by the native OpenCode CLI.

entries.name: IOpenCodeGateway.baseUrl
entries.summary: Explicit HTTP(S) endpoint without embedded credentials.

entries.name: IOpenCodeGateway.credentialEnvironmentName
entries.summary: Optional environment variable name; the secret value stays in the instance environment.

entries.name: IOpenCodeGateway.displayName
entries.summary: Safe provider display name; the host still owns its visible model catalog.

entries.name: IOpenCodeGateway.providerId
entries.summary: Stable native provider ID used as the prefix of provider/model identifiers.

entries.name: OpenCodeAuthDriver
entries.summary: Native OpenCode login/logout procedures scoped to one configured provider account.

entries.name: OpenCodeAuthDriver.login
entries.summary: Runs the configured native method and presents only safe login interactions.

entries.name: OpenCodeAuthDriver.logout
entries.summary: Logs out only the configured native provider in this isolated profile.

entries.name: OpenCodeAuthDriver.methods
entries.summary: Reports the native procedure only when provider and method selection are explicit.

entries.name: OpenCodeAuthDriver.status
entries.summary: Reads the CLI's isolated stored-credential listing without login or inference.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver
entries.summary: Executes installed OpenCode CLIs through their native noninteractive JSON protocol.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.auth
entries.summary: Explicit provider-specific native account lifecycle.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.capabilities
entries.summary: Native policy modes and locally validated structured output support.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.dispose
entries.summary: Stops and awaits processes owned by this explicitly injected runner.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.execute
entries.summary: Executes one selected native turn and normalizes only safe public events.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.id
entries.summary: Stable open driver identifier.

entries.name: OpenCodeDriver.inspect
entries.summary: Inspects this isolated CLI's credentials and advertised model identifiers without inference.

entries.name: importOpenCodeCredentials
entries.summary: Explicitly copies a native OpenCode credential file into one isolated application profile.

entries.name: AccountCooldowns
entries.summary: Shares only explicit account-scoped capacity evidence across sibling routes.

entries.name: AccountCooldowns.active
entries.summary: Reads a current account pause and removes only its expired record.

entries.name: AccountCooldowns.clearAccount
entries.summary: Clears one account after explicit recovery or native credential switching.

entries.name: AccountCooldowns.recordFailure
entries.summary: Records a bounded pause only when the provider explicitly identifies account-wide capacity.

entries.name: AiRouter
entries.summary: Runtime-local routing with host eligibility, bounded admission and explicit replay permission.

entries.name: AiRouter.dispose
entries.summary: Aborts and awaits only this router's queued/active operations; durable host state is preserved.

entries.name: AiRouter.execute
entries.summary: Executes a registered route with at most one attempt per configured candidate.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown
entries.summary: Versioned explicit account-capacity pause shared across sibling routes.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.accountId
entries.summary: Explicit account identity shared by sibling candidates.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.observedAt
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds when account capacity failed.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.reason
entries.summary: Native account-capacity classification.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.retryAt
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds when a new native attempt may be admitted.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.schemaVersion
entries.summary: Persisted cooldown schema version.

entries.name: IAccountCooldown.scopeId
entries.summary: Host namespace, isolating applications and workspaces.

entries.name: IAccountCooldownOptions
entries.summary: Default bounded account-capacity pause policy.

entries.name: IAccountCooldownOptions.maximumMilliseconds
entries.summary: Maximum accepted provider reset hint; default 31 days.

entries.name: IAccountCooldownOptions.now
entries.summary: UTC epoch-millisecond clock; defaults to Date.now.

entries.name: IAccountCooldownOptions.quotaMilliseconds
entries.summary: Fallback for explicit exhausted account quota; default 15 minutes.

entries.name: IAccountCooldownOptions.rateLimitMilliseconds
entries.summary: Fallback for explicit account rate limits; default 60 seconds.

entries.name: IAdmissionSnapshot
entries.summary: Current local scheduling state for a host scope and route.

entries.name: IAdmissionSnapshot.active
entries.summary: Number of executing operations.

entries.name: IAdmissionSnapshot.maximum
entries.summary: Configured maximum simultaneous operations.

entries.name: IAdmissionSnapshot.queued
entries.summary: Number of cancellable waiting operations.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions
entries.summary: Explicit host route composition and injected runtime-local routing policies.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.admission
entries.summary: Optional shared runtime-local admission controller.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.cooldowns
entries.summary: Optional shared account-capacity owner.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.governor
entries.summary: Optional shared governor; when supplied it owns its own store and clock.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.models
entries.summary: Optional shared account/model evidence cache.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.now
entries.summary: UTC epoch-millisecond clock for attempt timing; defaults to Date.now.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.routes
entries.summary: Validated route definitions; no ambient provider/account registration.

entries.name: IAiRouterOptions.store
entries.summary: Injected durable state adapter; default bounded in-memory storage.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions
entries.summary: Bounded cache lifetimes for authoritative account/model evidence.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.availableMilliseconds
entries.summary: Positive evidence TTL; default 5 minutes.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.maximumEntries
entries.summary: Maximum cached entries and simultaneous inspections; default 1000.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.now
entries.summary: UTC epoch-millisecond clock; defaults to Date.now.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.onInspectionError
entries.summary: Optional diagnostic sink; failures never replace the safe unknown result.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.unavailableMilliseconds
entries.summary: Negative evidence TTL; default 60 seconds.

entries.name: IModelAvailabilityOptions.unknownMilliseconds
entries.summary: Unknown/failed inspection TTL; default 15 seconds.

entries.name: IRoute
entries.summary: Host-owned route configuration; all candidates must already be authorized by the host.

entries.name: IRoute.candidates
entries.summary: Eligible candidates in stable configured order; no automatic catalog discovery.

entries.name: IRoute.id
entries.summary: Unique route policy identifier within this router.

entries.name: IRoute.maxParallelExecutions
entries.summary: Per scope/route concurrency, shared by all backup candidates; default 1.

entries.name: IRoute.maxQueuedExecutions
entries.summary: Maximum waiting operations for this route; default 256.

entries.name: IRoute.scopeId
entries.summary: Host application/workspace namespace for queues and durable routing state.

entries.name: IRoute.strategy
entries.summary: Selection strategy; default priority.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate
entries.summary: One host-authorized execution candidate with open provider and account identities.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.accountId
entries.summary: Account cooldown identity shared by sibling candidates in the same scope.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.costClass
entries.summary: Host cost class; default unknown.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.id
entries.summary: Stable candidate identity, unique within its host scope, used for telemetry and native session binding.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.inspectModelAvailability
entries.summary: Optional authoritative account-scoped inspector.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.instanceId
entries.summary: Registered runtime instance selected for this candidate.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.model
entries.summary: Provider-native model selected by the host catalog.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.priority
entries.summary: Lower values rank earlier; default 0 with stable input-order ties.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.providerId
entries.summary: Optional host-defined failure group for provider-wide circuit evidence.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.qualityScore
entries.summary: Host quality estimate from 0 to 100; default 50.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.reasoningEffort
entries.summary: Optional native reasoning setting.

entries.name: IRouteCandidate.sessionAffinity
entries.summary: Whether a matching bound native session ranks first; default false.

entries.name: IRouteGovernorOptions
entries.summary: Operational circuit policy and deterministic clock configuration.

entries.name: IRouteGovernorOptions.circuitCooldownMilliseconds
entries.summary: Elapsed circuit pause duration; default 5 minutes.

entries.name: IRouteGovernorOptions.failureThreshold
entries.summary: Consecutive failures opening a circuit; default 2.

entries.name: IRouteGovernorOptions.now
entries.summary: UTC epoch-millisecond clock; defaults to Date.now.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry
entries.summary: Versioned per-candidate or shared-provider operational history.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.attemptCount
entries.summary: Attempt reservations admitted for native execution; a pre-launch host failure may stop a reservation.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.averageLatencyMilliseconds
entries.summary: Mean duration of completed native attempts.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.circuitOpenUntil
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds until this circuit may be retried.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.consecutiveFailures
entries.summary: Consecutive provider failures since last success.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.failureCount
entries.summary: Completed provider failures, excluding cancellation and host failures.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.id
entries.summary: Candidate ID or explicit provider failure-group ID.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.kind
entries.summary: Separate namespaces prevent candidate/provider identifier collisions.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.lastAttemptAt
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds of latest attempt.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.lastFailureAt
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds of latest provider failure.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.lastSuccessAt
entries.summary: UTC epoch milliseconds of latest success.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.schemaVersion
entries.summary: Persisted schema version; unsupported versions fail without overwriting data.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.scopeId
entries.summary: Host-defined routing namespace.

entries.name: IRouteTelemetry.successCount
entries.summary: Completed successful attempts.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore
entries.summary: Bounded runtime-local state; capacity failure never silently discards an active pause or circuit.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.clearAccount
entries.summary: Clears only one account pause.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.clearScope
entries.summary: Releases all state owned by one host scope.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.loadCooldown
entries.summary: Reads one account pause.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.loadTelemetry
entries.summary: Reads one candidate or provider history.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.saveCooldown
entries.summary: Saves explicit capacity evidence without evicting other active pauses.

entries.name: MemoryRoutingStore.saveTelemetry
entries.summary: Persists history within the configured memory budget.

entries.name: ModelAvailability
entries.summary: Account-scoped evidence, with unknown intentionally distinct from unavailable.

entries.name: ModelAvailabilityCache
entries.summary: Bounded account/model evidence cache; failed or unavailable inspection remains unknown.

entries.name: ModelAvailabilityCache.clear
entries.summary: Clears only local metadata evidence.

entries.name: ModelAvailabilityCache.clearAccount
entries.summary: Invalidates only one account's evidence and rejects late cache writes from older inspections.

entries.name: ModelAvailabilityCache.clearScope
entries.summary: Invalidates one host scope without touching durable state or native credentials.

entries.name: ModelAvailabilityCache.inspect
entries.summary: Inspects only an explicitly supplied account-scoped metadata source; model catalogs alone are not entitlement evidence.

entries.name: RouteAdmission
entries.summary: Bounded cancellable admission shared by every backup candidate of a host scope/route.

entries.name: RouteAdmission.run
entries.summary: Waits for a local route slot and releases it before resolving or rejecting the operation.

entries.name: RouteAdmission.snapshot
entries.summary: Reads bounded local state without starting work.

entries.name: RouteCostClass
entries.summary: Host-supplied relative cost classification; Synapse never owns a model catalog.

entries.name: RouteGovernor
entries.summary: Deterministic candidate ordering and persisted candidate/provider circuit evidence.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.clearScope
entries.summary: Removes only state belonging to a host scope being closed or explicitly reset.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.history
entries.summary: Reads a safe candidate history for host projections and policy decisions.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.isAvailable
entries.summary: Checks candidate and explicitly grouped provider circuits at the current clock instant.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.order
entries.summary: Orders eligible candidates with stable ties and optional same-candidate session affinity.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.recordAttempt
entries.summary: Records admission before native execution; failures stop before provider launch.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.recordFailure
entries.summary: Records actual provider failure without counting cancellation or host errors.

entries.name: RouteGovernor.recordSuccess
entries.summary: Records success separately from executing the provider, preventing persistence-triggered replay.

entries.name: RouteStrategy
entries.summary: Deterministic selection strategies extracted from Symphony's routing governor.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase
entries.summary: Injected persistence boundary for host-owned routing telemetry and explicit account pauses.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.clearAccount
entries.summary: Clears only the selected account's pause after expiry, recovery or explicit account switching.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.clearScope
entries.summary: Removes the selected host scope's state through its authoritative lifecycle owner.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.loadCooldown
entries.summary: Reads the shared pause of one account.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.loadTelemetry
entries.summary: Reads an operational history without starting or retrying provider work.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.saveCooldown
entries.summary: Saves one complete account pause.

entries.name: RoutingStoreBase.saveTelemetry
entries.summary: Saves one complete immutable history snapshot.

entries.name: AiRuntime
entries.summary: Explicit provider-neutral execution owner for CLI text jobs and resumable agent turns.

entries.name: AiRuntime.configureInstance
entries.summary: Adds or updates a host-configured instance while preserving shared runtime state.

entries.name: AiRuntime.dispose
entries.summary: Stops owned operations, waits for cleanup and disposes explicitly registered drivers.

entries.name: AiRuntime.run
entries.summary: Starts one operation with optional observation and exactly one final result.

entries.name: BoundedAsyncQueue
entries.summary: Single-consumer event queue whose producer never waits for optional observation.

entries.name: BoundedAsyncQueue.[asyncIterator]
entries.summary: Claims the queue's single iterator; hosts may multicast its events externally.

entries.name: BoundedAsyncQueue.close
entries.summary: Ends observation after retained values drain, independently of the operation result.

entries.name: BoundedAsyncQueue.push
entries.summary: Publishes a value, dropping the oldest retained value when capacity is exhausted.

entries.name: FileProfileSessionStore
entries.summary: Atomic private profile metadata that invalidates native continuations across account or configuration changes and restarts.

entries.name: FileProfileSessionStore.advance
entries.summary: Persists a fresh generation before native credential mutation and preserves the configuration binding.

entries.name: FileProfileSessionStore.bind
entries.summary: Binds the profile to a canonical SHA-256 digest of its current native configuration.

entries.name: FileProfileSessionStore.read
entries.summary: Reads bounded versioned metadata while preserving absent legacy state.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions
entries.summary: Explicit composition and budgets for one local application runtime.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.access
entries.summary: Shared gate also passed to the host's authentication manager.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.defaultTimeoutMs
entries.summary: Default elapsed execution deadline in milliseconds, including queue time; default 30 minutes.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.drivers
entries.summary: Concrete drivers selected by the consumer; never loaded from a global catalog.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.eventCapacity
entries.summary: Retained normalized events per run; default 256, with explicit overflow summaries.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.instances
entries.summary: Isolated configured account instances, with unique identifiers.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.maximumPromptBytes
entries.summary: Maximum input prompt bytes; default 4 MiB.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.maximumRuns
entries.summary: Maximum active and queued runs in this runtime; default 128.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.router
entries.summary: Optional provider-neutral route executor.

entries.name: IAiRuntimeOptions.temporaryDirectory
entries.summary: Optional absolute parent directory for owned non-Git text workspaces.

entries.name: IInteractiveProcess
entries.summary: Explicit stdin and termination controls for a live native authentication process.

entries.name: IInteractiveProcess.end
entries.summary: Closes stdin after the final native procedure input.

entries.name: IInteractiveProcess.stop
entries.summary: Stops and awaits the owned process tree.

entries.name: IInteractiveProcess.write
entries.summary: Writes input to the owned process without logging its contents.

entries.name: INodeProcessRunnerOptions
entries.summary: Native process ownership budgets, independent of a particular CLI.

entries.name: INodeProcessRunnerOptions.maximumProcesses
entries.summary: Maximum concurrent owned subprocesses, default 32.

entries.name: INodeProcessRunnerOptions.terminationGraceMs
entries.summary: Unix graceful termination window before SIGKILL, default 500 milliseconds.

entries.name: IProcessRequest
entries.summary: Explicit subprocess intent; runtime owns launch, bounds, stream decoding and teardown.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.args
entries.summary: Native argument vector, never an interpolated shell command.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.environment
entries.summary: Complete allowlisted environment, supplied explicitly by the profile owner.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.executable
entries.summary: Resolved executable or CLI name to find through this request's environment.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.input
entries.summary: Initial stdin payload; may contain sensitive prompt or credentials.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.keepInputOpen
entries.summary: Whether stdin stays open for an interactive authentication procedure; default false.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.maxOutputBytes
entries.summary: Combined stdout/stderr byte budget; default 4 MiB.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.onStart
entries.summary: Supplies interactive stdin controls immediately after spawn.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.onStderr
entries.summary: Optional serialized stderr callback, with the same failure semantics.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.onStdout
entries.summary: Optional serialized stdout callback; exceptions cancel and drain the process.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.signal
entries.summary: Cancellation stops and awaits the process tree.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.timeoutMs
entries.summary: Elapsed timeout in milliseconds; default 5 minutes, at most 2147483647 for the native runner.

entries.name: IProcessRequest.workingDirectory
entries.summary: Existing working directory for this process.

entries.name: IProcessResult
entries.summary: Bounded captured output and native completion status of one owned subprocess.

entries.name: IProcessResult.exitCode
entries.summary: Native exit status, or null when terminated by a signal.

entries.name: IProcessResult.signal
entries.summary: Native termination signal name, if any.

entries.name: IProcessResult.stderr
entries.summary: Decoded standard error; never expose this raw value in user-facing diagnostics.

entries.name: IProcessResult.stdout
entries.summary: Decoded standard output, bounded by the requested combined output budget.

entries.name: JsonLineDecoder
entries.summary: Serial fragmented JSON-lines decoder with a bounded pending frame.

entries.name: JsonLineDecoder.finish
entries.summary: Processes the final optional non-newline-terminated frame.

entries.name: JsonLineDecoder.push
entries.summary: Accepts a UTF-8-decoded transport fragment and emits complete frames in order.

entries.name: NodeProcessRunner
entries.summary: Native executable/shim runner with bounded UTF-8 streams and awaited process-tree cleanup.

entries.name: NodeProcessRunner.dispose
entries.summary: Aborts all owned runs and awaits their process trees and result cleanup.

entries.name: NodeProcessRunner.run
entries.summary: Executes one explicit argument vector and resolves after native output and cleanup finish.

entries.name: ProcessRunnerBase
entries.summary: Replaceable operating-system execution boundary used by drivers and protocol replays.

entries.name: ProcessRunnerBase.dispose
entries.summary: Aborts and awaits all processes owned by this runner.

entries.name: ProcessRunnerBase.run
entries.summary: Starts one process and awaits completion plus owned cleanup.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator
entries.summary: Shared admission/drain owner for execution and native credential transitions.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.bindSession
entries.summary: Binds explicit credential/configuration sources under a drained exclusive transition.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.credentialChange
entries.summary: Drains execution, persists a new generation and only then invokes a native credential change.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.enter
entries.summary: Acquires an execution lease unless authentication currently owns the profile.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.exclusive
entries.summary: Blocks admission, cancels/drains active leases and serializes credential changes.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.invalidateSessions
entries.summary: Invalidates continuations before a native account or credential mutation.

entries.name: ProfileAccessCoordinator.sessionGeneration
entries.summary: Reads the authentication generation while the caller holds an execution lease or exclusive transition.

entries.name: ProfileSessionStoreBase
entries.summary: Persistent authentication-generation boundary, independent of native provider credentials.

entries.name: ProfileSessionStoreBase.advance
entries.summary: Advances the generation after execution drains and before credentials change.

entries.name: ProfileSessionStoreBase.bind
entries.summary: Binds native continuations to the current driver, configuration, environment and stable profile paths.

entries.name: ProfileSessionStoreBase.read
entries.summary: Reads the current generation without creating or resetting missing/unknown state.

entries.name: boundedText
entries.summary: Redacts common credential shapes and bounds a normalized progress message.

entries.name: createProfileEnvironment
entries.summary: Captures an allowlisted host environment and prepares one explicit isolated profile.

entries.name: snapshotAiInstance
entries.summary: Detaches an instance's account, paths and configuration from caller-owned mutable objects.

entries.name: IProcessReplay
entries.summary: One externally supplied native-process response, without importing a concrete AI provider.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.args
entries.summary: Optional exact expected argument vector; no prompts or credentials are recorded by the runner.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.executable
entries.summary: Optional expected executable; mismatches reject rather than replaying the wrong procedure.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.exitCode
entries.summary: Native status, defaulting to zero.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.onInput
entries.summary: Optional explicit observer for native stdin, which may contain secrets.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.signal
entries.summary: Native signal name, defaulting to null.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.stderr
entries.summary: Ordered standard-error fragments; consumers must redact them before presentation.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.stdout
entries.summary: Ordered standard-output fragments, retaining the external protocol's actual framing.

entries.name: IProcessReplay.waitForStop
entries.summary: Whether the external process remains live after its fragments until cancellation or stop.

entries.name: ISimulatedDriverOptions
entries.summary: Explicit synthetic driver behavior for deterministic tests and clearly labeled demonstrations.

entries.name: ISimulatedDriverOptions.capabilities
entries.summary: Optional native guarantees to exercise runtime capability checks.

entries.name: ISimulatedDriverOptions.events
entries.summary: Synthetic normalized events emitted through the actual runtime event sink.

entries.name: ISimulatedDriverOptions.id
entries.summary: Open driver ID, defaulting to simulated.

entries.name: ISimulatedDriverOptions.result
entries.summary: Explicit fixture result, or caller-supplied synthetic behavior; never a hidden AI fallback.

entries.name: ReplayProcessRunner
entries.summary: Replays sanitized external process fragments through actual provider parsing and normalization.

entries.name: ReplayProcessRunner.dispose
entries.summary: Cancels and awaits all live replayed invocations without creating an operating-system process.

entries.name: ReplayProcessRunner.run
entries.summary: Replays one native response through the caller's real serialized output callbacks.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver
entries.summary: Explicit synthetic execution through the same runtime contracts as real providers.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.auth
entries.summary: Optional supported native authentication owner.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.capabilities
entries.summary: Synthetic guarantees supplied to runtime capability validation.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.dispose
entries.summary: Releases implementation-owned resources after all its executions have been cancelled.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.execute
entries.summary: Emits fixture events and returns the explicitly supplied synthetic result.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.id
entries.summary: Open synthetic implementation identifier.

entries.name: SimulatedDriver.inspect
entries.summary: Explicitly inspects bounded metadata without initiating login or inference.
